name: Dark Vessels
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The Vilebranch fight with supernatural ferocity. This is due to the foul magical weavings of the Vile Priestess Hexx.

Throughout Jintha'alor you will find dark vessels of tainted blood. The vessels radiate the foul magic of the faceless blood God, empowering the Vilebranch and also driving them to madness.

Steal those vessels and return them to me so that I may remove the taint and ultimately loosen the grip of the blood God.
narrative.objectives: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.
narrative.offerRewardText: The dark energy that compels the Vilebranch has been lifted - for now. We must remain ever vigilant in our battle against evil, as even if the Vile Priestess is destroyed, another soon takes her place.
narrative.requestItemsText: Be cautious in battling the Vilebranch, adventurer. Their minds are clouded - they fight to the death.
